description:
Use this when you need an auditable Lithuania working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when lithuania 2026 Labour Code holiday facts with explicit mon_fri_planning or mon_sat_planning. Sixteen full-day statutory holidays; pre-holiday one-hour rules do not create additional rest. No weekend substitution or bridge is inferred. Required work_schedule selects a planning calendar, not a universal personal roster. Actual hours, pay, shifts, local/employer/sector/school/bank schedules, religious personal leave, legal deadlines and future years are not computed.
What it computes: Counts working/rest dates in the explicitly selected Lithuania 2026 five-day or six-day planning workweek. Sixteen statutory holidays; conditional one-hour eve markers never add full-day rest.
Example user requests: Count Lithuania working days around Restoration of the State is a statutory holiday. | Count Lithuania working days around August 14 shortening is not full-day rest. | Count Lithuania working days around Good Friday is not an Article 123 rest day. | Count Lithuania working days around Easter eve depends on selected workweek.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","end_date":"2026-12-31","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"start_date":"2026-01-01","end_date":"2026-12-31","work_schedule":"mon_sat_planning"}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_preholiday_rule_date, is_shortened_workday, statutory_shortening_hours, shortening_scope, working_hours_scope, personal_roster_scope, payroll_scope, shortened_work_dates_counted, shortened_work_date_count.
Formula: planning_workday = day in selected workweek AND no statutory_holiday_rest; shortened work dates count once
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/lithuania-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/lithuania-public-working-days-between.md

work_schedule.description: Required mon_fri_planning or mon_sat_planning. Choose the intended baseline explicitly; no universal or personal roster inferred.

name: count_lt_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Lithuania 2026 statutory holiday facts over explicit mon_fri_planning

day_type.description: statutory_holiday_rest, shortened_workday, weekend_baseline or regular_workday. Rest takes priority on overlapping eve markers.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_preholiday_rule_date.description: Whether result.date immediately precedes a statutory holiday, even on a rest date. A conditional rule, not personal entitlement.

is_shortened_workday.description: Rule-eve which is also working in selected baseline; no claim of actual hours worked.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is an Article 123 holiday, independent of weekend.

public_holidays_counted.description: Included distinct event dates, including conditional eves; list length is NOT a full-day holiday count.

shortened_work_date_count.description: Count of baseline working eves, not hours.

shortened_work_dates_counted.description: Included baseline working eves, already counted once as working dates; not all conditional eve markers.

shortening_scope.description: Required conditions and exceptions to the one-hour rule.

statutory_shortening_hours.description: Conditional rule magnitude: 1 on an eve including a rest/holiday eve, otherwise 0. NOT computed hours or entitlement.

work_schedule.description: Explicit selected five-day or six-day planning workweek.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Lithuania Working Days
